face_delight.what: estimated capture-room shine on the face (face_delight.py --stage separate) subtracted from the plate before the ratio; exact fg outside its weight

corneal.matte: tracked upper/lower(/lower_iris) parabolas AND the limbus disc, feathered; without a lid fit the mediapipe eyelid polygon, as the eye pass does; with neither, nothing
corneal.scale: anchor x exposure x gain -- the same anchor the plate is multiplied by, so render and plate share units

formula: out = plate x R,  R = E_target(rendered) / E_source(assumed)
why: the plate keeps every pore, hair strand and eye specular; the renderer supplies only the change in light. Rendering the proxy instead shows the proxy.

clamp.contrast_with_gain_map: relight_sh.py clamped BOTH ends at 1.5 stops, capping the whole map at 2.83:1, which is why it could never produce a terminator

plate_specular.why: a smooth R can recolour a highlight but cannot move or delete one, so with the plate specular left in, every shot keeps reporting where the ORIGINAL room's lamps were -- the crown sheen, the lip gloss, and the corneal catchlight most of all

source_band_limit.rule: you may only divide out lighting at the resolution at which you can put it back. Below the crossover E_target cannot restore what E_source removes, so R carries 1/E_source and brightens whatever the original key had shaded

specular.model: GGX + Schlick Fresnel on the NEURAL normals, added not multiplied
specular.light_direction: estimated per frame from the L1 moment of the rendered irradiance field, so it also works for environments
specular.magnitude: normalised GGX lobe (peak 1) x the rendered irradiance, so it carries the real light level, colour AND occlusion

catchlight.model: a dielectric mirror (IOR 1.376) at the measured corneal position, rendered with the plate camera, masked to the corneal cap, reduced to its compact part and added
catchlight.compact_only: the render minus its own local baseline. separate_specular.py only removes what stands above the local diffuse level, so the broad dim corneal reflection of the original room is STILL IN D. Adding the full mirror wash on top double-counts it and reads as a contact lens over the whole iris
catchlight.why_not_painted: presence, size, shape, colour and occlusion all come from the scene. A distance rule would get sunlight backwards: a mirror shows RADIANCE, which does not fall off with distance, so the sun makes a tiny brilliant spark rather than nothing
catchlight.keep_or_replace: computed from two MEASURED angles -- the plate key from its own catchlights, the scene key from the L1 moment of the rendered irradiance. Not an artist setting
